mentions.name: labrat
mentions.description: An early-stage tool for running semi-autonomous research loops, built to attempt replicating paper results overnight; already getting some use.
mentions.source_excerpt: inspired by the karpathy/twitter posts on running (semi) autonomous research loops, I build https://github.com/tnguyen21/labrat to be able to try and replicate some paper results over night. still early stages but I'm getting some use out of it already.
